svg.title: A short Python function with its tokens lit by the pole's strength, and meters of depth and strength. Tokens inside brackets are lit, most at depth 4, where strength reaches about 9. Tokens outside brackets are not. Tokens inside brackets in a comment and in a string are also lit, where the parser's depth stays at 0.
svg.text: L2 N676+ climbs as brackets open, and drops as soon as they close
A function written for this paper, read token by token. Blue shows the pole's strength at each token.
Grey text is a comment or a string: to the parser, brackets there do not count, but the pole fires on them.
Strength of L2 N676+, token by token
